item: Two tests that passed with the fault they inject removed now reach it: the existence-check fallback of the country migration and the not-there log of the vacuum preflight
summary: Each test was proved vacuous first by a mutant (delete the partial cleanup in the except Exception handler after os.link fails; scope the getsize replacement to a module the code does not read), both stayed green. The migration test now answers the first existence question for real and fails the second, counting link and question calls; the vacuum helper returns the log paths asked and the test asserts one. Same mutants turn both red. No src file.
